plans.name: ultramodern-checks-publish-tractor
plans.overview: Publish the shared UltraModern checks through the already trusted @modern-js/create package, migrate Tractor to consume it, and prove the live deployment still works.

todos.content: Expose the source-backed shared checks at @modern-js/create/ultramodern-checks, remove the new @modern-js/ultramodern-checks publish identity, and keep a create changeset.

Publish a fresh BleedingDev UltraModern cohort, verify npm latest/version/frameworkVersion, verify @modern-js/create/ultramodern-checks installs, and verify the removed checks alias is absent from the cohort.
Update Tractor package-source metadata, root dependency, wrapper script, validator, package manifests, and lockfile to consume @modern-js/create/ultramodern-checks from the published create alias.
Remove copied/generated regex checker logic from Tractor once the shared dependency is wired, keeping only thin wrapper scripts if the public script contract requires them.
Run Tractor install, ultramodern:i18n-boundaries, ultramodern:check, pnpm check, build, and cloudflare:build with the pinned repo pnpm.
Deploy Tractor Workers, prove public CSS/style output and package cohort, capture visual/browser evidence, then commit and push Tractor.
Close modernjs-0rlh and modernjs-9yiv with npm, gate, deploy, and Tractor commit evidence; keep Beads synced with bd dolt push.

plans.name: ultramodern-i18n-oxlint-rule
plans.overview: Replace generated regex i18n scanning with a source-backed Oxlint AST rule and shared runner that can be published and reused by generated apps and Tractor.

todos.content: Audit the UltraModern checks implementation and remove reliance on ignored dist-only artifacts; ensure the owning published surface has tracked source, package metadata, build scripts, and publish config.
Define the exact AST rule contract for hardcoded JSX text, visible literal attributes, ignore comments, technical-token attributes, and TypeScript generic/effect helper non-regressions.
Implement the Oxlint-backed shared rule/runner exported as single-app and workspace check APIs without app-specific regex allowlists.
Update generated single-app and workspace templates so i18n checks call the shared package through stable wrapper scripts while preserving public script names.
Add tests for real JSX copy violations, visible literal attributes, localized t(...) passes, ignore comments, technical-token elements, and TypeScript generic/effect helper false positives.
Run focused create tests, ultramodern workspace tests, package build checks, check-dependencies, and diff hygiene for the Oxlint rule changes.

plans.name: ultramodern-tracking-closeout
plans.overview: Close or update Beads that are now tracking stale state before starting the next implementation lane, especially xh9x and the Tractor umbrella.

todos.content: Audit existing docs and generated templates for the visible-attribute i18n explanation and subproject Oxlint/Ultracite policy required by modernjs-xh9x.
Close modernjs-xh9x if the evidence is sufficient, or update it with one concrete missing delta that must be handled by the Oxlint AST rule lane.
Recheck modernjs-u3xw dependencies and latest Tractor proof, then close the umbrella if modernjs-41je and modernjs-u3xw.1 fully satisfy it.
